nora (Support): Hi @maya — I opened a ticket for the double-charge Helix Labs reported. Can you confirm the invoice IDs and whether a PO was submitted?

maya (Helix Labs): Hey Nora. Yes — INV-2026-4451 (PO) and INV-2026-4452 (card). We submitted the PO at 2026-03-15T14:03:05Z, card charged at 14:02:28Z. Both posted within ~40s of each other.

samir (Billing Ops): That should've been caught by our duplicate detection (1h window). Sending logs now.

billing-bot: Duplicate-detection check: invoice_pair=INV-2026-4451,INV-2026-4452 status=NO_MATCH reason=metadata_mismatch tax_region=EU_VAT

samir (Billing Ops): Looking at the payloads — VAT fields differ. PO invoice has "vat_id":"IE12345"; card flow recorded "vat_applicable":true but no VAT ID. Our dedupe requires matching vat_id for EU reconciliation.

elaine (Finance): For EU customers we reconcile on VAT ID. If the card charge happens before PO arrives we usually do a manual reversal and then reapply the PO invoice to keep audit trail clean.

nora (Support): @maya quick question: do you want us to refund the card and keep the PO invoice active, or issue a credit against the PO and leave the card charge?

maya (Helix Labs): Please refund the card and keep the PO invoice. We need the PO-backed invoice for our procurement records.

samir (Billing Ops): Understood. Plan and internal repro steps:
```
# repro for ops
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/reconcile \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RECON_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"invoice_ids":["INV-2026-4452"],"reason":"duplicate_charge","action":"refund_card","metadata":{"vat_id":"IE12345"}}'
```
Note: include vat_id in metadata so the reconcile job links the PO properly.

nora (Support): Filed escalation to finance. @elaine can you approve the refund? ETA for customer reply and timeline to share.

elaine (Finance): Approved. Initiating card reversal now. reversal_id=RV-2026-778 expected_processed=2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. I'll also annotate INV-2026-4451 with vat_id and reconciliation_tag=manual_dupe so future runs skip it.

maya (Helix Labs): Thanks, appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

samir (Billing Ops): I'll follow up once the payment processor confirms. Adding a short runbook note to prevent similar false negatives (relax VAT match tolerance for closely timed flows). :eyes:

nora (Support): Closing loop here: customer informed, refund requested, finance approved. Will reopen if reversal fails.
